Do not claim success without deterministic concurrency/error/cancellation tests, real before/after hovers, and matched settled RSS. The measured original crash remains unresolved.

The thread-identified diagnostic 20261007T215121057Z-rsp-filter-inner-3954692-fb1a14/lookup-phase-attribution.json isolates foreground prefetch at 83871 and 106793 us, while visibility discovery is 234-241 us and composition 360-363 us. Large core DefMap reads occur on different background threads and are not charged as foreground decode. The existing prefetch uses four scoped readers, exact frozen transaction cells, dynamic assignment, no semantic-query concurrency and no permanent pool; five tests cover overlap, progress past a blocked artifact, cancellation, genuine errors and Arc release. Eight readers are a measured experiment, not a claim that p95 or idle acceptance will pass.
title: Should the existing temporary lookup-artifact prefetch use eight readers to reduce the measured first-hover artifact preparation delay?
wrong_if: Extra temporary readers may increase contention or transient allocation without improving first-hover p95. Retain the old binary and reports, preserve bounded cancellation and transaction release, measure full-count query/filter series and final matched idle memory, and revert to four if there is no useful benefit. No long-lived cache or scheduler changes are authorized by this decision.

title: Should the responsiveness checker score the complete current native latency matrix from a tracked evidence manifest, rather than repeat every genuine export session on every check?

The manifest must be a declared tracked input and name report content hashes under target/agent-debug; the checker must reject mismatched current native source/binary, observer scripts, pinned application inputs, compiler/configuration, incomplete cleanup and session-ledger/hash/count/readiness/type/window violations.
